name: War of Funerary Flame
desc: The war between the Dragon Lord Nibelung and the Heavenly Principles that took place 6,000 years ago.

customize.name: Nibelung
customize.desc: The leader of the elemental dragons and the primeval creator of Teyvat.

customize.text: Teyvat's primeval creator and Dragon Lord left Teyvat and journeyed into the dark universe to explore other worlds, leaving his rule to the Moon Goddesses. During his absence, the First Descender conquered Teyvat. When Nibelung obtained forbidden knowledge beyond the borders and returned to Teyvat, tainted by the Abyss, a second war between the dragons and the Heavenly Principles began.

customize.name: Heavenly Principles
customize.desc: The First Descender, who defeated seven Dragon Sovereigns of the world and created people. The Primordial One may be Phanes.

customize.text: When Nibuleng returned with forbidden knowledge, an unimaginable war took place in Teyvat, causing destruction on an unprecedented scale. In war, the victor would inherit the right to shape the world, while the losers must turn into ash.

customize.name: Moon Goddesses
customize.desc: Aria, Sonnet, and Canon — three sisters and Moon Goddesses who once ruled the firmament. Columbina Hyposelenia is a Moon Goddess who was born thousands of years after the Three Moon's death.

customize.text: During the War of Funerary Flame, the Moon Goddesses were unable to choose whom to support, so Nibelung decided they had betrayed him and imprisoned the sisters, turning the Moons themselves into weapons. The Heavenly Principles shattered two of the Moons and sent the third beyond the sky. From that moment on, the Goddesses ceased to belong to Teyvat and ultimately perished due to rejection.

customize.name: Nibelung
customize.desc: The leader of the elemental dragons and the primeval creator of Teyvat.

customize.text: The Dragon Lord was killed. His ally, the Dendro Dragon

did not give up on her attempts to change the course of history. She tried to gather new forbidden knowledge on the borders of a world that was hanging by a thread from destruction, but she was stopped by Celestia's divine nail.

customize.name: Heavenly Principles
customize.desc: The First Descender, who defeated seven Dragon Sovereigns of the world and created people. The Primordial One may be Phanes.

customize.text: Heavenly Principles won, although it came at a great cost. They remained in Teyvat, where they continue to rule to this day.

customize.name: Before Sun and Moon
customize.desc: A chronicle that ordinary folk have been forbidden to read. The writing is a mix of fables and histories from the beginning of the world to the creation of the Dainichi Mikoshi.
